The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Monday, January 5, 1931

Edwards Asks
For Salary
Demand Pay Until
Agreement Ends

The claim of Mr. E. M. Edwards,
secretary of the Shanghai Muni-
cipal Council, against the Council
is for salary up to the termination
of his present agreement with the
Council, which ends in September,
1932, and until then, it was as-
certained today.

Mr. Edwards, who has been su-
spended by the Council, filed his
suit with the Court of Consuls, com-
posed of the British, American and
Japanese consuls general.

The secretary, who is represented
by Mr. Stanley Harris, today de-
clared that the matter at this
stage is purely one of fact—i.e. the
agreement—and resides at the
Cathay Mansions.

It is understood also that the
agreements of the Council with two
other officers of the secretariat will
not be affected upon termination.
They are Mr. J. M. McRae, deputy
secretary, and who is now serving
as acting secretary, and Mr. J.
Pope, additional assistant. It is
reported that both have been ap-
pointed by the Council.

《上海晚邮报及信使报》，1931年1月5日，星期一

爱德华兹要求
支付薪金
要求支付至
协议终止

据今日查明，上海工部局秘书E. M. 爱德华兹先生向工部局提出的索赔要求是，支付薪金直至其与工部局现行协议终止为止，该协议将于1932年9月到期。

爱德华兹先生此前已被工部局停职，他已向由英国、美国和日本总领事组成的领事法庭提起诉讼。

这位由斯坦利·哈里斯先生代理的秘书今日声明，目前阶段此事纯属事实问题——即协议问题——并居住在国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）。

另据悉，工部局与秘书处另外两名官员的协议在终止时不会受到影响。他们是副秘书J. M. 麦克雷先生，目前正担任代理秘书，以及额外助理J. 波普先生。据报道，两人均由工部局任命。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REC.
No. S. B. D. 1903.
January 12, 1930. file 10 - 1 - 31

The Chung Pao, a mosquito newspaper(Address: Yoong
Bing Oen Lee, Newchwang Road) published the
following articles on January 8, 1930.

S.M.C. SECRETARY RELIEVED OF DUTY BY S.M.C.

Mr. Edwards, who was recently
relieved of his duty as Secretary of the S.M.C., joined
the Council in 1923 as Assistant Secretary and was
appointed Secretary in 1927 when Mr. Rowe tendered his
resignation owing to the May 30 incident. During his
seven years' service, he discharged his duties in a
satisfactory manner. He is a man of mild disposition
and is moderate in dealing with the affairs of the Council;
for this he incurred the great displeasure of his colleagues
who are radically-minded.

During the past year, Mr. Clear,
formerly Traffic Manager of the Shanghai-Nanking Railway,
joined the Secretariat of the S.M.C. He made great
changes in the organization of the Council and advocated
a reduction in expenses by cutting down salaries. The
result was that the pay of men of comparatively long
service was reduced but none of the newly employed staff
were affected by the change. Mr. Edwards' pay was
reduced by 50% but he raised no objection because the
New Party, which is supported by Mr. Fessenden, is very
influential. An outsider might infer that the
reduction of salary was made to compel Mr. Edwards to
resign, but Mr. Edwards was indifferent. The New Party
then accused Mr. Edwards of being slow in carrying out
his work and at the end of 1930 notified him that his
services were no longer required. Upon receipt of
the letter, Mr. Edwards demanded compensation to the amount
of $□□,□□□ from the Council for breaking the agreement
between himself and the Council, which does not expire

《中报》，一家小型报刊（地址：宁波路永明文记），于1930年1月8日刊登了以下文章。

工部局秘书被工部局免职

爱德华兹先生最近被免去工部局秘书职务，他于1923年以助理秘书身份加入工部局，并于1927年因五卅惨案罗威先生辞职而被任命为秘书。在七年的任职期间，他令人满意地履行了职责。他性情温和，在处理工部局事务时持中庸态度；因此，他招致了那些思想激进的同事的极大不满。

在过去一年中，前沪宁铁路交通经理克利尔先生加入了工部局秘书处。他对工部局的组织结构进行了重大改革，并主张通过削减薪金来减少开支。结果是，服务年限较长的人员薪金被削减，但新聘用的职员均未受到此次变动的影响。爱德华兹先生的薪金被削减了50%，但他未提出异议，因为得到费森登先生支持的新派系势力很大。外人可能会推断，减薪是为了迫使爱德华兹先生辞职，但爱德华兹先生对此漠然置之。随后，新派系指责爱德华兹先生工作拖沓，并于1930年底通知他不再需要他的服务。收到信函后，爱德华兹先生要求工部局赔偿□□,□□□美元，理由是工部局违反了他与工部局之间尚未到期的协议，

It is reported that the Council has

Mr. Edwards has rejected the offer.

CANDIDATES FOR THE POST OF CHINESE SECRETARY
TO THE S.M.C.

The Shanghai Municipal Council, which is
the supreme administrative organ in the International
Settlement, came into existence through the unequal
treaties. Consequently, the organization, administration,
and policy of the council are absolutely in favour of
foreign interests. As the Chinese residents in the
Settlement have not been given full protection, the
Chinese Ratepayers' Association has on several occasions
opened negotiations over this matter. The Council
subsequently increased the number of Chinese councillors
but the latter are acting as advisors only. They may
express their opinions in connection with matters
concerning Chinese interests but they have no authority
to interfere in the administration of the S.M.C. in
general.

Recently the S.M.C. proposed the engagement
of a Chinese Assistant Secretary in order to facilitate
dealings with the Chinese Authorities. The Council will
exercise great care in the selection of a suitable
person to fill this post. Seven persons have been
recommended by various people. Among the candidates
are Mr. Fong Ping Han, Mr. Han Ching Sien, and Mr. Tsai
Ling Ching, all of whom are qualified. However, Mr.
Fong Ping Han has the best chance because, besides being
a well known lawyer and enjoying a very good reputation,
he is on intimate terms with the prominent officials of

据报道，工部局已向爱德华兹先生提供1,000英镑作为退休金，但爱德华兹先生拒绝了这一提议。

工部局华务秘书职位的候选人

上海工部局是公共租界的最高行政机构，它是通过不平等条约建立的。因此，工部局的组织、管理和政策完全偏向外国利益。由于租界内的中国居民未得到充分保护，华人纳税会已就此问题多次进行谈判。工部局随后增加了华董的人数，但后者仅充当顾问角色。他们可就涉及华人利益的事项发表意见，但无权干涉工部局的一般行政管理。

最近，工部局提议聘用一名华务助理秘书，以便与中国当局打交道。工部局将在选拔合适人选担任此职时极为谨慎。各方共推荐了七人。候选人包括冯炳汉先生、韩庆先先生和蔡令清先生，他们均具备资格。然而，冯炳汉先生最有希望获选，因为他不仅是一位知名律师，享有良好声誉，而且与
